footerTagline: A salon experience in the heart of Ljubljana, crafted around precision, care and modern artistry.
aboutIntro: STATUS KAY was founded on a simple idea: a salon experience that treats hair as a craft, not a commodity.
storyText1: After traveling the world and refining my craft abroad, the desire to open my own salon was born. What began as a small studio in the heart of Ljubljana has grown over almost a decade into one of the city's most trusted studios for colour and cut — without losing the personal attention that started it all.
storyText2: I build every visit around a real consultation, honest advice and techniques refined over years of working with all hair types, so what you leave with actually fits your life, not just the photo you brought in.
meetText1: I've been in hairdressing for many years, and it's exactly this craft that lets me combine precision with creativity. By nature, I'm extremely meticulous — every detail, from the shade to the very last strand, matters to me.
meetText2: But what I love most is working with people: the conversations during an appointment mean just as much to me as the result you see in the mirror. When I'm not behind the chair, you'll usually find me on a walk with my dog — my loyal companion on every step — gardening, or out on my bike.
value1Text: Every colour and cut is treated as a technical discipline, refined through continuous training.
value2Text: Premium, hair-first products and treatments that protect condition as much as they transform it.
value3Text: Realistic advice at every consultation — we tell you what will genuinely work for your hair.
servicesPageIntro: From subtle dimension to full transformation, every service starts with a consultation so the result is built around your hair, not a trend.
service4Text: Blow-dry, event and editorial styling finished to a luxury salon standard.
service5Text: Careful correction for colour gone wrong, restoring condition alongside the shade.
service6Text: Nail shaping with no polish, or gelish/long-lasting polish, finished with the same precision as our hair services.
service7Text: Classic foil highlights for dimension and brightness, from subtle to full-head.
service8Text: Precise fades, beard shaping and old-school scissor cuts, done properly.
service9Text: Post-colour toning to neutralise brassiness and perfect your final shade.
servicesNote: Prices vary by hair length, density and the technique used — you'll get a precise quote at your consultation.
service1SeoDescription: Balayage hair colouring in Ljubljana — soft, natural colour transitions and luxury finishing techniques at STATUS KAY, near the main train station.
service1LongText: Balayage is a freehand colouring technique that creates soft, natural colour transitions without harsh lines. At STATUS KAY, every balayage is tailored to your base colour, length and hair texture, so the result looks sun-kissed rather than salon-made. The price includes lightening and toning; styling is not included.
service2SeoDescription: Professional blonding in Ljubljana — premium blonde transformations tailored to your skin tone and hair condition at STATUS KAY.
service2LongText: Blonding is one of the most demanding colour techniques, requiring a precise read of your hair's condition and the right tone selection. It's often referred to as the 'double process' technique. At STATUS KAY, we assess your hair first, choose a shade that flatters your skin tone together, and take the process in stages to protect hair quality along the way. We use quality lighteners with Wellaplex technology, which preserves the hair's bonds throughout the process.
service3SeoDescription: Women's haircuts in Ljubljana — precise cutting techniques tailored to your face shape at STATUS KAY, near the city centre.
service3LongText: A good haircut is the foundation of every hairstyle. At STATUS KAY, we cut women's hair with precise tools, tailored to face shape, density and hair texture, so the style holds its shape between visits.
service4SeoDescription: Blow-dry and event styling in Ljubljana — polished looks for occasions and photoshoots at STATUS KAY.
service4LongText: For special occasions, weddings or photoshoots, we offer bespoke styling — from a classic blow-dry to more elaborate updos. We tailor the appointment to your event and overall look.
service5SeoDescription: Hair colour correction in Ljubljana — expert fixes for colour gone wrong at STATUS KAY, restoring both shade and condition.
service5LongText: When a colour service hasn't gone to plan, we're here to fix it. Colour correction takes patience and experience — at STATUS KAY, we first assess your hair's condition, then rebuild toward the shade you wanted in stages, prioritising hair health throughout.
service6SeoDescription: Manicure and nail care in Ljubljana — classic and gel finishes at STATUS KAY, in the same visit as your hair appointment.
service6LongText: A manicure at STATUS KAY is as considered as any of our hair services — shape and cuticle care with no polish, or with gelish/long-lasting polish, all in one relaxed visit. Pair it with your usual hair appointment or book it on its own.
service7SeoDescription: Hair highlights in Ljubljana — classic foil highlighting for dimension and brightness at STATUS KAY.
service7LongText: Highlights are the classic route to lighter hair with more dimension — foiled sections lifted to your chosen tone, from a few face-framing pieces to a full head. At STATUS KAY we match the placement and intensity to how low-maintenance or dramatic you want the result to be. Highlights are also a great option for covering the first signs of grey, blending them in naturally.
service8SeoDescription: Barbering in Ljubljana — fades, beard trims and men's grooming at STATUS KAY.
service8LongText: From clean fades to beard shaping and old-school scissor cuts, our barbering service covers proper men's grooming from consultation to finish. Regular clients book a standing slot to keep everything sharp between visits.
service9SeoDescription: Hair toning in Ljubljana — neutralise brassy tones and fine-tune your colour at STATUS KAY.
service9LongText: Toning is the finishing step after lightening or highlights — a gentle glaze that neutralises brassy or yellow tones and settles your hair into a clean, even shade. It's quick, low-commitment, and makes a noticeable difference to how fresh your colour looks.

privacyIntroText: This page explains what personal data the STATUS KAY website collects, how we use it, and what rights you have over it.
privacyDataText: The only personal data we collect is what you enter in the contact form — your name, email address and message. This site has no server or database of its own: when you submit the form, it simply opens your own email client with the message pre-filled, and you send it yourself. Nothing is stored on our end.
privacyUseText: Anything you email us is used solely to respond to your enquiry. We don't use it for advertising, sell it, or share it with third parties.
privacyThirdPartyText: The How To Get Here page embeds a Google Maps view, and the Booking page links to Fresha for online booking. Both services operate under their own privacy policies, which are outside our control.
privacyRightsText: Because the message you send through the contact form goes straight from your own inbox, you're always in full control of it and can delete it at any time. For any privacy questions, reach us at the email below.
